description: Turns the four knobs of the Twister immediately to its left into CV outputs, with a vMIDI output beside them

params.text: Chooses the span the CV outputs cover: 0-10 gives 0V to 10V, 0-5 gives 0V to 5V, and -5-5 gives -5V to +5V

outputs.text: The knob of the same number on the Twister as a voltage in the span RANGE sets, slewed towards each new value in place of stepping to it
A vMIDI cable carrying the controller messages arriving from the hardware, for Kilpatrick's patchable MIDI modules rather than for a voltage input

notes: it goes immediately to the right of a Twister and puts out nothing on its own
